title: Report: Micah Parsons could start the season on PUP list

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Micah Parsons could start the season on PUP list
sources.description: Packers General Manager Brian Gutekunst said earlier this month that the team expects edge rusher Micah Parsons to return early in the 2026 season after recovering from a torn ACL, but did not put any more specific time frame on how much time Parsons could miss.
